architecture_decisions:
:
- **One execution truth.** Engineering Run, attempts, worker checkpoints/leases, source lineage, provider records and protected evaluation remain authoritative; run events and Live Build are observational projections.
work_items:
:
- **One execution truth.** Engineering Run, attempts, worker checkpoints/leases, source lineage, provider records and protected evaluation remain authoritative; run events and Live Build are observational projections.
validations:
:
- **One execution truth.** Engineering Run, attempts, worker checkpoints/leases, source lineage, provider records and protected evaluation remain authoritative; run events and Live Build are observational projections.

AC-01: validate protected requirement — A database-backed reference run using the production event sink/repository produces an ordered persisted observation sequence covering the governed lifecycle through REVIEW without creating a second state authority.

AC-02: validate protected requirement — Recreating runtime/services and replaying operations preserves one accepted mutation/publication path, monotonic event sequence and exactly one accepted GitHub branch/commit/PR plus Vercel Preview publication.

AC-03: validate protected requirement — The permanent reference proof records a real failed TEST attempt with normalized failure evidence, recovery/correction, and a subsequent successful exact-lineage TEST/VERIFY path; the failed fact remains queryable and is never normalized to success.

AC-04: validate protected requirement — Protected source tree/file and diff reads match immutable accepted lineage digests/content and demonstrate the correction relationship. Stale, unrelated or foreign lineage identities fail closed.

AC-05: validate protected requirement — BUILD/TEST/VERIFY reads expose only allowlisted normalized evidence and durable identities; deliberate secret/raw-provider/unbounded-log cases are redacted/rejected and cannot reach the observer payload.
AC-06: validate protected requirement — Foreign Project, run, lineage and attempt-evidence reads cannot disclose protected state or content, while owner-scoped reads remain functional.

AC-07: validate protected requirement — The permanent client/browser acceptance proves ordered replay/SSE resume without duplicate UI events, evidence-backed failure/recovery/REVIEW/provider/source views and usable desktop/mobile Warm Editorial composition.

AC-08: validate protected requirement — The reference run reaches REVIEW/HUMAN_REQUIRED before operator action; observation does not mark the run COMPLETE. A separate explicit operator review may then complete the permanent reference flow.

AC-09: validate protected requirement — Reference-app restart/replay/provider/evaluation tests, worker recovery, source-lineage protection, protected promotion evaluation, auth/Project/Work Specification/Engineering Run tests and browser/mobile suites remain unchanged or stronger.

AC-10: validate protected requirement — The additive run-event migration is reviewed/tested for idempotent application, constraints/RLS/revokes are defined, startup guard requires the table under exact activation, and the flag-first rollback path is recorded before production migration.

AC-11: validate protected requirement — The final candidate contains an authentic committed P2-V0.17.5 SpecCritic/SpecCompiler plan and passes Workstream Spec Validation, Parallax P2 CI, Bounded Autonomy, protected promotion evaluation, browser/accessibility/visual acceptance and required Vercel checks on the exact head.

AC-12: validate protected requirement — After AC-01 through AC-11 pass, the production database receives the additive `engineering_run_events` migration and verification proves expected table/constraints/indexes/RLS/revokes before the activation flag changes.

AC-13: validate protected requirement — `PARALLAX_RUN_EVENTS_ENABLED` is set to exact `1` only after schema verification, the exact validated Wave 4 application head is promoted, and deployment metadata plus health/readiness/auth/observability/web/runtime-log checks pass.

AC-14: validate protected requirement — `ARCHITECTURE.md` and `DESIGN-SYSTEM.md` reflect durable Wave 4 architecture/design changes; `CURRENT-STATE.md` records exact production deployment/migration/activation evidence only after those facts are verified; `PROJECT-CONSTITUTION.md` changes only if durable governance policy changes.
risks:
:
- **One material risk and mitigation.** Deliberate TEST failure is persisted and visible before bounded correction; no evaluator/UI layer rewrites it as success.

critique: The permanent integrated reference harness extends the existing protected AppBuilder reference infrastructure, using a database-backed Engineering Run/attempt records, a `PersistentRunEventSink`/`RunEventRepository`, immutable lineage storage, protected implementation and exact-lineage execution, worker/process recreation seams, bounded delivery drivers and the protected evaluator. The harness produces a run-owned durable event sequence, covering the governed database-backed runtime facts. The permanent reference proof uses database-backed references, a `PersistentRunEventSink`/`RunEventRepository`, immutable lineage storage, protected implementation, worker/process recreation seams, bounded delivery drivers, and the protected evaluator.
